candidates.speaker: client
candidates.text: Yes, please provide the quote and timeline for both items.

candidates.speaker: client
candidates.text: Let’s postpone the lander work for the time being. Regarding the creative, your proposed price is far too high. We also never supply raw footage or voiceover. The successful ad I shared was created entirely by another freelancer, who charged 2500/- per video. He is a subject matter expert, but I’m here because he is currently unreachable and I therefore cannot get this done through him. You would need to handle everything, including the footage, voiceover, and script. Our budget is 8k inr for 3 video ads of 30sec each, delivered as 6 finished files.

candidates.speaker: client
candidates.text: Let’s begin with 1 video so I can evaluate the quality you produce.

candidates.speaker: client
candidates.text: Before I award the project, please write out the complete scope of what you will do. State that you will use actual footage for the advertisement and that you won’t create the video with an avataar or static image. Also include every other technical element you will handle, such as proper lipsync.

candidates.speaker: client
candidates.text: Regarding the benefits, I already shared a video with you that explains all the benefits offered by the medicine.

candidates.speaker: client
candidates.text:
A link to your product or landing page (if available). - My landing page contains adult content, so it would not help with this.

We have many customer reviews - However, it would be better for you to create them yourself because most of ours come through calls and are not in a suitable format. They are not recorded on the site.

Preferred Audience - The audience we generally attract falls within the age range of 35-65+.

candidates.speaker: client
candidates.text: Please also make sure the video has suitable cuts and the correct Audio dB, as both were deficient in the looser video.

candidates.speaker: client
candidates.text: You may send me the offer as well, and I’ll accept it. Please include the complete scope, including appropriate cuts and Audio DB 25 in accordance with proper standards.

candidates.speaker: client
candidates.text: Keep in mind that the content should have a viral style. You may revise the script if you want; use the key words and change it in whatever way you believe will make it viral. Also remember that the Video must feature only Indian Actors, preferably Male.

candidates.speaker: client
candidates.text: The new video must not come across as a copy of the winning creative. You should develop it from your own fresh perspective—for example, couples discussing it and sharing feedback, or several patients speaking about it in a testimonial style.

candidates.speaker: client
candidates.text: Here is 1 additional reference video for you to review. It is also performing successfully on Meta.

candidates.speaker: client
candidates.text: Hook : This is not strong; it is far too indirect, and users will not pay attention to it. Such an indirect approach will not work in India. You need to select and use keywords from the reference videos I shared. This entire concept will not work at all.

candidates.speaker: client
candidates.text: Sending the reference videos served no purpose if you were going to take such a safe and indirect approach. It will not perform. Please discard the entire script. Carefully listen to and understand the 1st video and the final video I sent today, extract key words from them, and build the new script around those.

candidates.speaker: client
candidates.text:
Please follow these steps:
1\. Use the script from the last reference I sent, since that script is good.
2\. Identify its keywords and core message, because we want to communicate that same message.
3\. Your task is to determine how to improve that script. Find what is weak or missing, remove it, and replace it with something more powerful. Do not include anything generic. Everything we say should feel unique while still delivering the same message.

candidates.speaker: client
candidates.text: Remember that the purpose of this Video ad is to improve conversions, not merely to make it more aesthetically appealing. We need a high-converting ad rather than one that only looks good.

candidates.speaker: client
candidates.text: The keywords centered on energy, confidence, stamina and performance are generic terms that we do not use, because using them makes the cpl too high, as I also told you last time. Please use keywords such as timing and dheelapan. Review the transcript from my winning video and the last reference I shared, then identify and write the keywords and send them here. The ones you have currently written—Energy, confidence, stamina—definitely do not work. You must also send the entire script in Hindi only.

candidates.speaker: client
candidates.text: I understand that terms such as confidence and stamina need to be included, but there are additional keywords that must be used as well. Can you send me the complete script entirely in Hindi?

candidates.speaker: client
candidates.text: Instead of sending the script, do this: create 10 sec shots first so I can evaluate whether they are working. They must be in Hindi, with no english, because I cannot visualize from the script how the final result will look.

candidates.speaker: client
candidates.text: Remove the word लिंग and do not use it. The benefits are the same.

candidates.text: Review the last reference I sent. I want something similar, with additional benefits taken from my winner script and the last ref script.

candidates.speaker: client
candidates.text: I have already sent you the images for product 1. This is the 2nd product, and I do not have a proper image of it. Use AI to produce improved pack shots for this product.

candidates.speaker: client
candidates.text: Include both the products there.

candidates.speaker: client
candidates.text: This product is for Diabetes. I shared it because the last reference I gave you presents Diabetes as the problem. However, whether you choose to include it is up to you.

candidates.speaker: client
candidates.text: It is fine if you can deliver it within the next 12 hrs. Otherwise, please leave the task. We needed an expert and cannot work with someone who starts this slowly. A person with expertise would take only a few hours to create this. Therefore, I don’t believe you understand this field or are an expert in it.
